gate: Gate 5 internal flange tabs, hidden joints, and internal panel ribs

reinforcement_ribs.slicer_union_strategy: Each recessed gusset and hub remains a closed, overlapping internal solid in its shell STL; the 0.5 mm designed shell overlap is unioned by the slicer without risking a non-manifold CAD boolean at multi-panel vertex fans.
reinforcement_ribs.status: Both panel sides of all 55 source-panel connections internal to the four requested body shells are reinforced; 38 triangulated hubs overlap every shared main-gusset endpoint, while the compact opposite-side gussets clear the hub zone. Inter-shell flange seams, outer edges, rear base, and ears are excluded.

upper_planar_rear_frame.alignment: coplanar with the rear edges of left_upper_head and right_upper_head

hardware.body: Internally accessed M3 through-bolts with washers and M3 nyloc nuts through matched flange tabs
hardware.ear: Two internally accessed M3 through-bolts with washers and M3 nyloc nuts per matched ear-root tab pair
hardware.threadlocker: medium-strength removable threadlocker only on metal-to-metal threads

deferred: removable rear service cover and gasket
review_notes: Gate 5 is a full-size internal flange-tab candidate and must be physically validated with a 100 mm assembly and full-size coupons before production printing.

Each matching flange-tab pair and both light triangular gussets on every internal source-panel connection are printed as part of their shell. A triangulated internal hub overlaps the full end section of every main gusset meeting at a shared source vertex; compact opposite-side gussets stop outside the hub zone. Gate 5 exports no separate printed joiners.

Triangular internal panel ribs and main-gusset hubs are limited to left_lower_face, left_upper_head, right_lower_face, and right_upper_head. They do not run along inter-shell flange seams, outer edges, the rear base, or either ear.
All M3 through-bolts, washers, and loose nyloc nuts are inside the head; the approved exterior has no fastener holes.

The rear-base section is a closed 20 mm-surround, 18 mm-deep trapezoidal frame with a reduced wiring/service opening. Four continuous concealed connector rails follow its outer interfaces and six internal M3 paths attach all four adjacent body shells; no isolated tabs remain inside the opening.
The bike connector flange and rail load path remain deferred.
